payload.text: Asking a notes verb about a commit materialises that commit's whole tree, its own bytes, at a root outside the project and removes it on every exit path including a refusal, so a status run cannot alter the dirt it reports; the tree is written from an index of its own rather than by git archive, so no export attribute can drop or rewrite a path and make a correct release read as unstamped or its views STALE, and the limits that remain -- smudge filters and submodules -- are declared.
